dedupe.manualFallback: List open self-improve tickets and match exact fingerprint first, then provider, command family, and error class.

selfImprove.commentPolicy: If a matching open ticket exists, add sanitized evidence as a comment instead of creating a duplicate.
selfImprove.commentTemplate: Additional evidence from <target-repository> at <iso-8601-timestamp>: fingerprint, platform, tool/provider, command family, sanitized symptom, attempted command, verified workaround, safety confirmation.

auth.missingAuthBehavior: Prepare the sanitized ticket body locally and report the blocked self-improve write.

selfImprove.writeApprovalPolicy: Agents may create or comment self-improve tickets only after user approval for the current task.

openQuestions.question: Select and configure the self-improve ticket sink, or confirm that tracker none is intentional.
openQuestions.neededBefore: Agents can create or comment self-improve tickets.
